Create an Accrual Plan

User manual · English · 7 steps
Learn how to start an accrual plan, which gives employees time off gradually as they work, and where its levels are added.

1. Open Time Off

Open the Time Off app.

2. Configuration menu

Open the Configuration menu.

3. Accrual Plans

Click Accrual Plans.

4. New

Click New to create a record.

5. Name

Type the name, then press Tab.

6. Save

Click the save icon to keep the record.

7. Saved

The record is saved. Click its name in the breadcrumb to finish.
